body.statement:
Along \(n_\ell=2\ell\) and \(m_\ell=2\lceil\gamma\ell\rceil\), first determine, on nonempty subsequences satisfying the lower-bound regime, whether
\[
\inf_{\widetilde U\in\mathfrak E_{n_\ell,m_\ell}}
\sup_{P\in\mathfrak P^{\mathrm{pred}}_{n_\ell,m_\ell}(r,\mu,K,q,B,\lambda)}
E_P[\mathcal L(\widetilde U,U)]
\]
has order \(b_{n_\ell m_\ell}\), an intermediate order, or constant order within the proved \(b_{n_\ell m_\ell}\)-to-constant bracket.  Only if the risk is of order \(b_{n_\ell m_\ell}\), determine the finite normalized constant \(C_\star\).  Then decide whether an optimal observed-data estimator, or recorded IPW--SVD in particular, attains that rate and constant, and whether a nonconstant predictable propensity path can be least favorable.

obligation.what_is_open: Determine the minimax order inside the proved \(b_{nm}\)-to-constant interval on the nonempty fixed-complexity predictable class; only if it is \(b_{nm}\)-order, determine the finite normalized constant \(C_\star\), attainment, and least-favorable propensity paths.
obligation.obstruction: The constant-propensity Fano family supplies only a \(c b_{nm}\) converse.  Nonemptiness forces \(\lambda_{nm}\le2B\sqrt{nm}\), so the proved spectral radii are nonshrinking at fixed complexity and the hybrid upper side is only constant.  The adaptive endogenous-target construction excludes \(b_{nm}\)-attainment for recorded IPW--SVD but is not an estimator-independent converse.
obligation.attempted: The lower side was reduced to a bounded constant-propensity Fano experiment; matrix Freedman and deterministic subspace perturbation produced the loose IPW radius; the accepted adaptive construction tested that estimator; and the discrete-sine fallback was optimized into a single admissible hybrid estimator with constant risk.
obligation.partial_result: Under the small-\(b_{nm}\) and signal-ceiling conditions of the lower theorem, the same expected normalized maximum-row loss satisfies \(c b_{nm}\le\inf_{\widetilde U\in\mathfrak E_{n,m}}\sup_P E_P\mathcal L(\widetilde U,U)\le\sup_P E_P\mathcal L(\widehat U^{\mathrm H},U)\le C(1\wedge a^{\mathrm{loose}}_{nm})\).  In every nonempty fixed-complexity bounded-aspect regime, \(a^{\mathrm{loose}}_{nm}\gtrsim\sqrt{\log n}\), so the achievable side is constant wherever the lower theorem also applies; no all-estimator impossibility above \(b_{nm}\) has been proved.

body.justification: The live question is first whether minimax risk has order \(b_{nm}\), an intermediate order, or constant order; an exact normalized constant comes only after that rate gap closes.
body.gap: An observed-data estimator improving the constant hybrid upper bound or an estimator-independent lower bound larger than \(b_{nm}\) is still missing under the frozen assumptions.
body.consumer: A resolution would determine the attainable design-budget and signal-strength law before any sharp-constant calculation.
